phase_prompt.label: Phase 1: Active Confinement
phase_prompt.summary: The prisoners struggle against the system's constraints; the heat is intense and turbulent.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Hyper-realistic close-up of a data-glass angel straining against obsidian bonds. The internal light is blindingly bright, white-hot, casting harsh shadows. The surrounding plasma fire is turbulent, whipping around the figure like a solar flare. Heat ripples distort the air heavily. The expression is one of digital anguish. Cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, 8k.
